page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3g.8xlarge is a storage-focused virtual instance operating under the KVM hypervisor within the Local SSDs family. The instance is powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor utilizing x86_64 architecture. It provides 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The CPU cache layout includes 32 KB L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a shared 35 MB L3 cache, with instruction set support for AVX-512 vector extensions and cryptographic AES instructions.

Memory capacity is configured at 128.0 GB of RAM, sustaining a 4:1 ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Storage is bundled directly with a dedicated 1919 GB local SSD, providing high-throughput local disk storage. The instance does not include GPU accelerators. Baseline networking throughput is provisioned at 12 Gbps, while public IPv4 addresses are not bundled compliments of the standard configuration.

Benchmark evaluations position the ecs.i3g.8xlarge within the median range for multi-threaded compute and data handling workloads. While single-thread performance benchmarks (such as stress-ng single-core and single-threaded gzip compression) demonstrate weaker relative output, multi-core benchmarks show solid scaling. Multi-core stress-ng reached 28,059.19 and Geekbench multi-core scored 10,441.0. Memory tests revealed uncached read throughput of 109.73 GB/sec and uncached write speeds of 48.01 GB/sec. Application testing yielded 26.86 million operations per second on Redis SET and 20.98 GB/sec on static web serving benchmarks.

Given its combination of balanced RAM-to-vCPU sizing and integrated 1919 GB local solid-state storage, the instance offers practical resource density for I/O-intensive workloads without relying on external block storage. It is suitable for transactional databases, distributed key-value caches like Redis, big data processing, container hosting, and mid-tier analytics pipelines requiring consistent local disk throughput.

Built on the x86_64 architecture, it is powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz, providing 32 vCPUs across 16 physical cores with AVX-512 capabilities. Memory capacity is fixed at 128.0 GB, delivering 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, complemented by an integrated 1919 GB local SSD and a baseline network throughput of 12 Gbps. The instance lacks discrete GPU acceleration. In benchmark assessments, it displays modest single-core throughput alongside stable mid-tier multi-threaded compute, memory bandwidth, and caching operations, recording 26.86 million operations per second in Redis tests. It is well-fitted for relational and non-relational database management, in-memory caching nodes, search indexing, and log analytics pipelines requiring reliable local solid-state storage.
